Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries at all — it’s very simple to start 👍
Here’s the easiest way to begin with your Nurosym:
Put a tiny bit of moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear)
Clip the earpiece onto your left ear, cable goes over and behind your ear
Turn it on
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling
Keep it on for about 15–60 minutes per session while you go about your day
You can use it while reading, working, relaxing, or even before bed. Many people use it daily for around 30–60 minutes, often in the morning or split between morning and evening.
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually build up. It should always feel comfortable, not strong.
If you want, I can also walk you through a simple daily routine to make it even easier 👍
